notes:
Stormbreak 0.8.1 - Clearer threats

Enemy aircraft, minibosses and bosses now have a restrained warm contour with a thin dark backing, helping their silhouettes stand out over active scenery while preserving their original materials.
Hostile bullets have a bright cream centre, pink body and dark edge. Their visual footprint is slightly larger for readability; collision radii, damage, speed and patterns are unchanged.
The treatment works in Low, High and Ultra, including Reduced flashes, without pulsing highlights or added bloom. Player weapons, pickups, environments, saves and progression are unchanged.
